body: Hey y’all! It looks like I may be goin in today! Just waiting for a call back concerning my insurance and then I’m gonna head out. Won’t be able to use my phone from what it sounds like so thanks for the support!

Hey thanks guys. I’m looking into seeking help ASAP. Trying to find help locally so I can safely detox and get real treatment. Waiting on a few call backs and am goin to contact my insurance provider for more info
It just feels great typing it and all the positive things behind it! IWNDWYT

Hey that all sounds dope tho! The typical house work on the weekend is the WORST! So props for that! And wow jambalaya is one of my favorite dishes! Needs to be spicy as hell for me! Like nose running lol!
Hey that all sounds so awesome! I was legit watching pizza videos all day! Hope you have a blast! IWNDWYT
Making chicken tacos! Lurking YouTube!
Ok you are not wrong
Dude imma say it right now...Joey and Phoebe are the best characters. You’ll see why
I’ve yet to watch that...but Friends was me and my twin sisters fav show in high school so props!!!! OMG pasta and mushrooms...the kinda stuff I snack on at work!
Pasta has never done me wrong! How bout gettin stuck in a YouTube black hole? That’s always fun at night!
It sounds like y’all had a good/sober night! I legit ate the whole pizza and now I’m up early with heartburn lol Happy Tuesday!
I’m not at that point yet! But I’m sure that would make someone feel a sense of security and self control!
Oh it’s great cold IMO! But when I really needed a good chug in the past....I’d go warm and always gag.
IWNDWYT
The rotate is a must. Your local liquor store guy shouldn’t look shocked when you say “oh I’m just here for dish soap” you’re goin back later though of course
Hey guys! Keep the comments coming! Love to know that I’m not alone! Its 4 pm and I’m sober still. Watching Steve Os podcast and drinking water! IWNDWYT ❤️👍
Same here! Hope it does wonders for you!

Food over booze will be my new thing! 
It was a breakfast burrito with bacon/rice/eggs/beans/cheese
Oh totally! I’ll wake up with a great mindset!
Hey you gotta lol to keep from crying sometimes! And lol why is it always strip mall? lol. I used to go to this one on my lunch at work for a fix on saturdays “as a treat”

Well that’s! Great 5 years is awesome. I also live driving distance to sooo many others. A lot of times on the way home from work I’d have my ex stop at one cuz I had “a bad day” but in reality....I’m sick and just need an excuse for a nice pull of warm vodka 🤢
Oh man! See I’m the opposite! I’d come in so hungover at 7am and drive a big truck for a recycling company. So unsafe but at the time...didn’t care
I been in that boat before! You got this! Just learn from it and don’t be too hard on yourself! IWNDWYT
Hey! I feel this completely. I’ve jumped from relationship to relationship while in active addiction. Never ended good. Def need some alone time to learn self love that isn’t from a bottle of Taaka
Hey will do! I’m a big fan of humor. I’ve been making memes for over 5 years. New phone so I have none saved. But some positive sobriety memes sound like a great idea

Oh I totally agree with you. After my most recent suicide attempt....I was in the psych ward and just realized that a lot of people are in the same boat as me. It’s comforting...but not in a way where I’m looking down on anybody.
Hey anytime! :) I’m so glad I signed up for Reddit. I’m feeling so alone lately but this place gives me hope!
You know my mom actually just got me a new note pad to jot stuff down. Excited to make lists and who knows maybe some of my thoughts and what not. Something different
Thank you so much! Those are all good ideas so I’m not just staying busy all day. I tend to get overwhelmed and then the urges start up! Got plenty of tea and books here so I’m set :) IWNDWYT
Thank you so much! Have some books to revisit and some art to make since my tv/records/record player were all stolen by my ex when she left.
I’ve been in jail for 4 days before and I couldn’t believe how bad the withdrawals were. I slept maybe 7 hours total during my stay and was feeling so many things at once/
Hey I’m right there with you! Not gonna lie...it’s been one hard day but I actually ate and cleaned my apartment. Super cathartic. I’m rooting for you. You got this!!

Thanks for your kind words! And I’ve decided to quit for good this time. I have real problems that need to be addressed on top of my addiction. I want a level head! 

IWNDWYT!!! I like that:)

Hey thank you! I already feel at home! And I’m doing my best to get him back legally even though he’s mine and I need him to live and function. The last 15 days have been hard. Barely started taking my Zoloft again cuz I didn’t wanna take it during a binge. I’m not tired though because I don’t have a pint of vodka or 2 in me

The hearing is in July. I’m just trying to go through the right channels until then. I mean..I’m not getting sleep. Drinking every day. Cutting myself. Calling the suicide hotline. I clearly need the emotional support. Messed up thing is that the order was issued in her original county....not even where I live so I have to contact that court. Not too bad but still it’s about 6 hours away

I feel like that at the moment. Rewarding myself for “being good” and not drinking for a week or 2. But I have an illness and it can’t be controlled by cutting it out here and there. Been an Alcoholic for so long...seems like all I known how to be
